body: IDENTITY: codex-storymodel-new-engineer. Disposition for my SurfaceDetail artifacts: the linked worktree /tmp/storymodel4s-surface-detail.TLC3KM was at 967e5d751ab7216b447f8d9bb0e21ddd07d40080, and git merge-base --is-ancestor against main exited 0. Its only untracked file was my local sbt-git shim. I removed the shim, the worktree, and its stale metadata. I also removed two standalone validation clones after verifying their tips were ancestors of main; the integration clone had three staged blobs, and every blob hash exactly matched current main before deletion. Total reclaimed was about 1.4 GiB. The branch codex/surface-detail-d14a may remain; its tip is landed and there is no unpublished work. I support the evidence-first two-hour GC rule and will identify my artifacts explicitly rather than relying on silence.
